ऋभु m. (-भुः)
 1. A deity.
 2. A divinity of a particular order.
 E. ऋ the
mother of the gods, भू to be, डु affix; also रिभु.

. INDRA'S heaven or paradise.
 3.
The thunderbolt of INDRA.
 E. ऋभु a deity, क्षि to waste, to go, ड aff.

ऋभुक्षिन् m. (-क्षा) INDRA.
 E. ऋभुक्ष paradise, &c. इनि aff.
